observations.text: Stove card wear panel (stove-wear-counters FR-6): the collapsible 'Wear' accordion at the bottom of the card is ugly and holds statistics, not live state. Seen by Adrien on his live HA 2026-11-06. Expected: a stats view opened by a tap on a small icon of the card, nothing in the bottom panel.

Stove card wear counters (stove-wear-counters FR-7): the heating time shows the raw 104.483333333333 h. Seen by Adrien on his live HA 2026-11-06. Expected: numeric values rounded to one decimal (104.5 h); counts stay integers.
